'''Angelo Vistoli''' (born 1 June 1958, [[Massa Lombarda]])<ref name=cv>{{citation|url=https://homepage.sns.it/vistoli/CVVistoli.pdf|title=Curriculum vitae|access-date=2024-08-04}}</ref> is an Italian mathematician working on [[algebraic geometry]].

==Career==
Vistoli earned a [[laurea]] (the Italian equivalent of a master's degree) in 1981 at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref name=cv/> He became a student of [[Michael Artin]] at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]], where he completed his Ph.D. in 1987 with the dissertation ''Duality in the Intersection Theory of Moduli Spaces''.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|44938}}</ref>

After becoming Benjamin Pierce Lecturer and assistant professor in mathematics at [[Harvard University]], he returned to Italy as a professor at the [[University of Basilicata]] in 1990. He moved to the [[University of Bologna]] in 1993, and to the [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa]] in 2006, where he is professor of geometry.<ref name=cv/>

In 2024, he succeeded [[Andrea Ferrara (astrophysicist)|Andrea Ferrara]] as president of the Classe di Scienze (Faculty of Science) of the [[Scuola Normale Superiore]].<ref>{{cite web|url= https://normalenews.sns.it/angelo-vistoli-nuovo-preside-della-classe-di-scienze-per-il-prossimo-triennio-accademico |language=italian |title=Angelo Vistoli nuovo preside della Classe di Scienze per il prossimo triennio accademico  |website=normalenews.sns.it |date=27 June 2024}} </ref>
